answer_2.quote: We use micro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 score for evaluation based on the standard formulation of Precision = T P/(T P +F P ), Recall = T P/(T P + F N ), and F1 = 2 * Precision * Recall /(Precision + Recall)... We propose the partial match precision, recall, and F1 by treating each predicted span or ground-truth answer span as a string.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators were provided with a category-specific annotation guide... and annotated the data on a per-category basis... The first-pass annotation was according to the following four categories: Good example, Bad question, Bad answer span(s), Bad question-answer pair.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators followed a category-specific annotation guide and classified instances into: Good example, Bad question, Bad answer span(s), Bad question-answer pair.
